description: Issues the invoice from the business's tariff and the reported work, only after the proof pack. Needs state PROOF_PACK. Never: Invent a price or skip the gate. Platform fee CHF 0.18 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

flow_id.description: The flow (job) id, which is also its chain id.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every mutate and money call; a retry with the same key returns the same result and is not charged again.

quote_id.description: A valid quote for this capability (quote).

name: invoice_issue
title: Issue the invoice
